description.value: Doc Morgan's is an oceanfront restaurant and pub on Bowen Island serving elevated West Coast comfort food with an emphasis on fresh local seafood, including oysters and fish and chips. Located at the Union Steamship Marina, it is the island's main sit-down dining destination and caters to both casual visitors and private group events. For a touring cyclist arriving by ferry, it offers a welcoming spot to refuel with a full menu in a waterfront setting.
